snippet.description:
In this episode of Minutes With, we sit down with former Navy SEAL @JasonRedmanww to hear his extraordinary story of resilience, survival and recovery.

Jason shares how he first set his sights on becoming a Navy SEAL, what it took to survive some of the toughest military training in the world, and how the events of 9/11 changed the course of his career.

He also reflects on combat, leadership, the mistake that almost ended his career, and the life-changing ambush in Iraq that left him with severe injuries. Jason opens up about recovery, almost 40 surgeries, the sign he placed on his hospital door, and how he rebuilt his life after being given a second chance.

snippet.title: FOMO (Fear Of Missing Out)
snippet.description:
Welcome to Money's Hidden Past! Why do incredibly smart people consistently buy into the market at the worst possible time? The answer is a 400-year-old psychological trap: Financial FOMO (Fear Of Missing Out). When asset prices skyrocket, the absolute terror of being left behind while everyone else gets rich causes us to abandon all logic, research, and risk management. But this isn't a modern internet problem—it is a glitch in human psychology. Join us as we explore four historical eras of speculative mania. From 17th-century Dutch Tulip bulbs and the South Sea Company, to the Dot-Com frenzy of the 90s and the viral Dogecoin mania of 2021. Discover why human psychology hasn't changed in four centuries, and learn how to protect your portfolio from the ultimate financial illusion.

snippet.title: Gordon Ramsay's American Food Adventure | America 250 Special | Uncharted MEGA Episode | Nat Geo
snippet.description:
Celebrate America's 250th anniversary with Gordon Ramsay and National Geographic and explore the people, landscapes, and regional food traditions that help define the United States. In this 2+ hour Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted Mega Episode, Gordon travels from Louisiana's bayous to the Great Smoky Mountains and the rugged landscapes of Texas in search of authentic American cuisine, local ingredients, and unforgettable culinary traditions. He experiences a crawfish boil, rappels down a waterfall to fish for trout, and crafts his own spin on Texas barbecue. Featuring three, full episodes: 

Louisiana's Bayou Cuisine - 00:00 
When Chef Ramsay is told that “Cajun comes from the soul,” his soul searching takes him to South Louisiana’s swamps to test his skills and his luck.

The Great Smoky Mountains - 44:02 
Gordon rappels, kayaks, and forages his way through the Smoky Mountains in a hunt for some of the most unique ingredients the region has to offer. 

Texas Throwdown - 01:28:04
Chef Ramsay learns the meaning of “Texas Tough” as he herds cattle, catches a rattlesnake and hunts feral hog in the Lone Star State.

snippet.description:
Welcome to Money's Hidden Past! What if I told you that one of the smartest men in history, Sir Isaac Newton, lost his life savings in a massive financial trap? In 1720, the British government was drowning in national debt. Their solution was the South Sea Company, a corporation that promised investors unimaginable riches from overseas trade. But there was one massive problem: the company was a complete house of cards. Driven by political bribery, insider favors, and rampant FOMO, the stock price exploded before violently collapsing to zero. Garcia’s close relationship with the Gambino captain Greg DePalma and key events such as a violent assault in a Bloomingdale's led to the indictment of 32 mobsters.
